# Harness Summary

The harness exhibits a critical **label collapse problem** across all three datasets: the model systematically over-predicts a single label (doxo-lonu in alpha with 37.5% eval accuracy, bravo-stoji in beta with 47.9%, doti-solko in gamma) rather than discriminating among the full label set, suggesting ineffective demonstration sampling or prompt framing. Training accuracy remains low (28–37%), indicating the model struggles to learn from demonstrations in-context, while the recurring bias toward specific labels appears mechanical—the model selects the same default regardless of input semantics. The context window size varies across datasets (342–512 chars) without apparent correlation to accuracy, and all three datasets show identical reasoning patterns ("Closest demonstrations suggest [label]") without meaningful signal extraction. To improve, focus on diverse demonstration selection covering all labels, analyzing why certain classes become defaults, and verifying that demonstrations genuinely distinguish classes rather than clustering around a few popular labels.
